canonical_units.label: Сложные прилагательные/сочетания: четыре специально запоминаемых написания 6 класса
canonical_units.learner_rationale_policy: This is deliberately one contrast unit: its pedagogical value is that visually similar first components lead to three different writing models. Do not invent one universal derivational rule that supposedly explains all four.
authoritative_support: Russian Orthographic Dictionary / Gramota for all four spellings
Current academic adjective rules distinguish lexicalized terms from free adverb+adjective combinations and hyphenated equal/colour-shade compounds.
